create_video_recorder: create a VideoRecorder instance with a root directory, render size, fps, and camera id
init_video_recording: init the VideoRecorder with an environment to start recording frames
record_environment_frame: record a single frame from the environment using the VideoRecorder record method
save_video_to_disk: save recorded frames to disk as a video file using the VideoRecorder save method
log_video_to_wandb: log recorded frames as a video to Weights and Biases using the log_to_wandb method
